post.description:
Upload a file (max 5MB) to storage and get back a durable CDN URL. Send the raw file bytes as the request body with `Content-Type` set to one of the accepted mime types listed below.

Uploads are deduplicated per workspace by SHA-256 of the payload — pushing the same bytes twice returns the existing record (`200 OK`) rather than creating a duplicate. A fresh upload returns `201 Created`.

Trial accounts are limited to 20 uploaded assets. Dedupe hits don't count against the cap.

post.summary: Batch-check which asset hashes already exist
post.description:
Given a list of SHA-256 content hashes, returns a map of each hash to its existing asset record (or `null` if not stored in this workspace). Lets syncing clients skip the upload round-trip for content that's already been uploaded — compute the hash locally, batch-check, then only POST the missing ones to `/assets`.

Max 100 hashes per request.

200.description: Map of `hash → asset record or null`. Keys are the hashes from the request; values are the existing asset for that hash, or null if not found.

url.description: CDN URL of the uploaded asset

post.summary: Animate a template with a preset
post.description: Applies a named preset to layers, optionally staggered. Deterministic and free: no model call, no AI credits, and the same request always produces the same keyframes — three layers at `stagger: 500` begin at 0, 500 and 1000ms exactly. Use this whenever the request already says what it wants. The template is versioned before it is overwritten.

preset.description: FadeIn, FadeOut, ZoomIn, ZoomOut, GetBigger, GetSmaller, ScaleIn, ScaleOut work on any layer. PopIn and PopOut are measured in `em` and apply to text layers only.

objects.description: Layer ids, in the order the stagger should run. Omit to animate every layer in stacking order.

duration.description: How long each layer's tween runs, in milliseconds

stagger.description: Milliseconds between each layer's START. At 500, layers begin at 0, 500, 1000 — not 500ms of gap after each finishes.

merge.description: Keep keyframes on layers this call does not touch. False replaces the whole timeline.

duration_seconds.description: Derived from the template's keyframes — not settable. 0 until something is animated.

post.description: Start a workflow. Async — returns 202 immediately; poll GET /workflow_runs/{uid} until `status` is `completed` or `failed`. Steps run in order, each feeding the next. A run charges nothing itself: each step is billed as the resource it creates, so a run costs exactly what running its steps individually would. To process many rows, POST once per row — each is its own run.

items.description: A single animation keyframe. Timing fields (delay/duration/endDelay) advance the object's timeline; any of the animatable attributes sets a target value the object tweens to over `duration` ms. Blank fields are ignored — omit any attribute you don't want to animate.

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after the previous frame ends before this frame's tween starts. Capped at 10000.

duration.description: Milliseconds the tween runs for. Must be > 0 for the frame to occupy time. Capped at 10000.

endDelay.description: Milliseconds to hold the frame's final state before the next frame's delay starts. Capped at 10000.

easing.description: anime.js easing function applied to this frame's tween. Defaults to easeInOutQuad.
